name: tersign
description: Official Tersign plugin — counter-signed evidence for agent commerce. Verify a counterparty's receipts and evidence bundles offline with no account, and put your own agent's actions on a neutral, independently verifiable record.

plugins.name: tersign
plugins.description: Counter-signed evidence for agent commerce. Verify any counterparty's x402 receipt, action record or evidence bundle OFFLINE with no account and no API key; issue counter-signed receipts and disclosure records into a neutral hash-chained ledger anchored to Bitcoin; export a dispute-ready envelope for the venue that will hear it.
